 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manash Ranjan Pathak
 Order
11-12-2024
Heard Mr. R. Chetri, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. K. K. Parasar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State.

2. Apprehending his arrest, the petitioner, namely, Sri Niraj Khemka, son of Banwari Lal Khemka,
resident of Jalan Kunj, 31 Kedar Road, Fancy Bazar, P.S.-Bharalumukh, District- Kamrup (M) has Page No.# 1/2 vs The State Of Assam on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80941532/
1 filed this application under Section 482 of the BNSS, 2023 seeking pre-arrest Page No.# 2/2 bail in Dispur P.S. Case No. 376/2024 corresponding to G.R. No.4247/2024 registered under Sections 420/406 IPC.

3. Earlier, the Court by order dated 21.10.2024 while calling for the case diary of said Dispur P.S.
Case No. 376/2024, granted interim bail to the petitioner, named above, in said Dispur P.S. Case No. 376/2024, which was extended only upto 26.11.2024.
Thereafter, the said interim order was not extended.

4. During the deliberation of the matter, Mr. K. K. Parasar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor,
Assam on instruction, submitted that police after completion of investigation of the case has already submitted the final report in said Dispur P.S. Case No. 376/2024 vide Final Report No. 3276/2024 dated 31.08.2024.
5. In view of the above, this pre-arrest bail application of the petitioner, being infructuous stands rejected.
6. The interim bail granted to the petitioner on 21.10.2024 in said Dispur P.S. Case No. 376/2024 is hereby recalled/stands vacated.
